features.title: Catalog Item S3 Image Upload, Bid Material Picker & Owner Item Review
features.description: Closes the loop on the contractor catalog → bid → owner-review workflow. (1) Adds true S3 image upload for catalog items (presign + finalize, png/jpg/jpeg/webp ≤5 MB) plus an uploader on the catalog UI with thumbnail rendering. (2) Adds a per-task material picker on the bid submission form so contractors can select items from any of their catalogs, set quantity, and bind them to a specific task in the bid. The materials_subtotal column on bid_task_breakdown is recomputed from these selections. (3) Adds an owner-side item review on the bid comparison page: each task line shows attached material cards with thumbnail + brand + line total, and clicking any item opens a modal popup with full image, manufacturer, model, specifications, and unit price — so the homeowner can vet the actual products before approving the bid.
